firm_note.text: Founded 2004 by Thomas Connelly; underwent a formal ownership transition in July 2023 in which Connelly transitioned majority ownership to Elizabeth Shabaker and newly-arrived Royce Ramey (who joined to open the Dallas office), with Connelly staying on as Chairman Emeritus/Investment Committee. A separate owner of record, 'Remington Revocable Trust' (dated 3/28/2014, 25-50% owner), has no identifiable human trustee/beneficiary in any independent source found — genuine search (press coverage of the 2023 transition, Versant's own announcements, general web search) turned up no connection between 'Remington' and any of the five people profiled here, and no public filing naming a trustee. This remains unresolved; do not guess.
firm_note.source: citybiz.co/article/446546 (Versant Capital Management Announces Ownership Transition, July 2023); AZ Big Media (azbigmedia.com/business/versant-capital-management-announces-ownership-change-and-expansion); Remington Trust link independently searched via web search with no corroborating result

Royce Creighton xxx-xx-xxxx RAMEY.bio_note: Same individual as the clean-named 'Royce Creighton Ramey' owner record (data artifact from an SSN-redaction parsing bug, not a second person). Co-CEO and CIO; joined Versant in July 2023 specifically to establish its new Dallas office, and simultaneously took majority ownership alongside Elizabeth Shabaker as founder Thomas Connelly stepped back. Previously Managing Director and Chief Experience Officer at Tolleson Wealth Management in Dallas, and before that provided family-office services to ultra-high-net-worth families at GenSpring Family Offices in Phoenix. Texas Tech University graduate (BBA Finance and MS Finance, both summa cum laude); holds the CFA charter and is active in the CFA Institute's Dallas-Fort Worth Society. Serves on the board of the Perot Museum of Nature and Science, chairing its Investment Committee. Featured as a contributor on the Forbes Finance Council.
Royce Creighton xxx-xx-xxxx RAMEY.bio_source: Forbes Finance Council contributor profile (councils.forbes.com/profile/Royce-Ramey-Co-Owner-Co-CEO-Versant-Capital-Management); citybiz.co ownership transition article (citybiz.co/article/446546); corroborated via versantcm.com/team/royce-ramey
